units: <cite ref="Berakhot 55a:10">Ber. 55ᵃ</cite> <he>שלשה דברים … רעב וש׳ וכ׳</he> three things does the Lord himself announce: famine, plenty, and a good leader.

<cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 5:3">Tosef. Pes. V, 3</cite> <he>חגיגה … פסח נאכל בש׳</he> (Var. <he>על הש׳</he>) the pilgrim’s sacrifice … must be eaten first, so that the Passover offering be eaten after the appetite is satisfied; Y. ib. VI, 33ᶜ <he>לָשׂבַע</he>; Bab.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91:8">Gen. R. s. 91</cite> <he>שני השָ׳</he> the years of plenty.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 97a:2">Snh. 97ᵃ</cite> <he>ש׳ ואינו ש׳</he> plenty and no plenty (partial plenty); <he>ש׳ גדול</he> general plenty; a. fr.
